subject: ARLO SEO — Weekly Pulse — 2026-07-24
html:
Week 7 Pulse

Shipped since last pulse (2026-07-17): /compare hub index page (2026-07-20, closed a gap flagged 3 prior pulses/sessions) and the first blog post, "What Is an MCP Connector?" (2026-07-23, targets the KD 11 mcp connector term). Below is where the numbers stand — several rows are still pending because the automated GSC/GA4 data pulls aren't wired into this sandbox yet.

Leads proxy (GA4 conversions)

Pending — GA4 (G-CP22NBPLFP) is firing, but this sandbox has no outbound GA4 API access. Still waiting on the scheduled data Action (12-week-strategy.md Week 8, not yet stood up) to backfill this row.

Ranking movement

KeywordLast wkNowTrend
No data — see "Anything broken?" below

Traffic vs last week

Pending — same root cause as rankings: no SE Ranking tracking project for askarlo.app. Re-checked SE Ranking's own organic index live this session (getDomainOverviewByCountry, US) — still zero indexed organic/paid keywords for askarlo.app, and getAiSearchOverview still shows null brand_presence, 0 link_presence, 0 ai_opportunity_traffic. Expected for a domain this new and this recently launched, but it also means we still have no instrument reading at all, three pulses running now.

Anything broken?

No build/pipeline regressions. SEO Report Email Action: 10 of 11 runs green since 2026-07-04 (the one failure was the very first shakeout run, before the pipeline worked end-to-end); every run since — including today's — sent and archived cleanly. Both shipping sessions since the last pulse (compare-hub index 2026-07-20, MCP-connector blog post 2026-07-23) logged a clean npm run build + npm run lint per the worklog.

Still open: the SE Ranking rank-tracking gap, flagged 2026-07-10 and again 2026-07-17, has not been closed. Re-confirmed this session — still no SE Ranking project for askarlo.app (checked the full account: 33 other client sites tracked, none of them Arlo). Two more content sessions have shipped since the last pulse with zero rank visibility into any of it — that's now 7 pages/posts total since this gap was first flagged. This routine can't create the tracking project itself (recurring paid keyword-tracking commitment, a setup decision, not a reporting one) — needs a human or a dedicated session to: create an SE Ranking project for askarlo.app, add the P1 keyword list from audits/keyword-research.md, Google US + CA search engines, weekly checks.

Also still open: the Meta Ads / catalog.ts launch-status decision, flagged 2026-07-06 (now 3 weeks/6 sessions old). src/lib/connectors/catalog.ts still marks 9 real, working connectors (Meta Ads, HubSpot, Salesforce, Mailchimp, MailerLite, Pipedrive, GoHighLevel, Clarity, GTM) as coming_soon/waitlist despite the Jul 18 product commit making them functionally live. This blocks a whole second wave of connector-matrix pages beyond the 4 already shipped (Meta Ads MCP alone is a named P1 keyword) — needs a human call on whether to flip the catalog or confirm it's intentionally lagging.

Reading the week

Two real gaps closed this week — the /compare hub fixed a standing internal-linking issue, and the blog engine is now live with real content instead of just infrastructure. Meanwhile the P1 keyword demand curve keeps climbing in SE Ranking's own index: "google ads mcp" monthly volume jumped 390→590 in the last month (+51%), "google analytics mcp" 320→390 (+22%), and "mcp connector" (this week's blog target) has tripled over the past year (70→210) though it held flat month-over-month. "claude mcp server" is steady at 810/mo. The wedge this whole strategy is betting on is real and growing. But three pulses running now, with 7 pages/posts shipped into that demand curve, we still have zero instrument telling us whether any of it is landing — the SE Ranking rank-tracking gap is no longer a minor loose end, it's the single biggest blind spot in this program. Recommend the next available human session prioritize standing up SE Ranking tracking (and resolving the catalog.ts call, which is separately blocking Meta Ads) over further new-page content — the build-out is now well ahead of the measurement layer.
